decisions.label: Home's start (areas)
decisions.note: How many areas home has at a campaign's start (Ed, 2026-11-04: "home has 5 areas chosen at random from the phase 1 creatures, and grows as you unlock islands"): home has one area per island she's found, and while that's fewer than this, home's starting kinds whose islands she hasn't found fill it up to this, a different choice each night. Its legends are 1 in 5 areas, as any island's (Ed: "Home legends: Same as other islands, which I think is 1 in 5? But including undiscovered islands of phase 1 if possible"). 10 was the old home. A new map: it reloads.

decisions.label: Home's challenge at (islands found)
decisions.note: How many islands she must have found before home gets its challenge area and its find (Ed, 2026-11-04: "When you unlock every island, home gets a challenge area and you get a special reward for completing it"; "no find at home until endgame"). 64 is every island on the chart; lower it to play home's endgame early. Its pack is an adult and a youth of each kind on home tonight. Its reward for now is the challenge's find (Ed: special reward to be decided). A new map: it reloads.
